name: Zernio
summary: Marketing infrastructure for agents: social, ads, inbox, WhatsApp, SMS and calls behind one API key, with an MCP server included. First two accounts are free.
description: Marketing infrastructure for agents: social, ads, inbox, WhatsApp, SMS and calls behind one API key, with an MCP server included. First two accounts are free.

pricing.details: Usage-based: first 2 connected accounts Free, no credit card; 3–10 accounts 5 €/month each; 11–100 accounts 3 €/month each; 101+ accounts 1 €/month each; starting at 0 €/month. Enterprise custom past 2,000 accounts (SAML, SCIM, MFA, audit logs, RBAC, SOC 2 + GDPR paperwork). Official: every feature included, nothing gated behind a plan. Messaging: first 10,000 sent DMs a month free, then metered (official message rates live on a separate page and are not restated here).
